name: ColBERTv2: Effective and Efficient Retrieval via Lightweight Late Interaction
problem: Late interaction's multi-vector representations inflate the model's space footprint by an order of magnitude, limiting index size.
mechanism: Aggressive RESIDUAL COMPRESSION - dimensionality reduction plus sparse outlier retention, discarding the dimensions that carry little relevance signal - combined with a denoised supervision strategy that trains against false negatives. The query is also optionally truncated.
speedup_reported: Establishes state-of-the-art quality within and outside the training domain while reducing the SPACE FOOTPRINT of late-interaction models by 6-10x. The baseline is ColBERT and the metric is index size, which is the memory-bound dimension that matters for serving.
notes:
Venue NAACL 2022 (crossref: ACL, 'Proceedings of the 2022 Conference of the North American Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics'). This is the paper that made late interaction deployable: 6-10x index reduction is the difference between a ColBERT index that fits and one that does not. Combined with a dimensionality-aware query, ColBERTv2 is the reference configuration for any late-interaction deployment, and it is the checkpoint PLAID is built against.
